settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These numbers decide your prices: what you earn per piece, what you take on each parcel, how far you go down and after how long. They exist only in this database — never in the code, never in the repository.
settings.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to save.} one {One setting saved.} other {# settings saved.}}

minMarginCents.label: Minimum margin (cents)
minMarginCents.hint: What you want to clear on a sale once contributions, payment fees, purchase price and shipping are deducted. This number sets the floor price of a negotiation.

contributionRateBps.label: Contributions (basis points)
contributionRateBps.hint: 1230 means 12.30 %. French micro-enterprise rate for resale of goods.

stripePercentBps.label: Stripe variable fee (basis points)
stripePercentBps.hint: 150 means 1.50 %. The exact figure is in your Stripe contract.

stripeFixedCents.label: Stripe fixed fee (cents)
stripeFixedCents.hint: Taken on every payment, whatever the amount.

shippingMarkupPercent.label: Shipping markup (%)
shippingMarkupPercent.hint: Added to the carrier cost to get the shipping charged to the buyer.

packagingWeightGrams.label: Packaging weight (grams)
packagingWeightGrams.hint: Added to the weight of the piece to pick the carrier’s weight bracket.

floorShippingZoneCode.label: Reference zone for the floor price
floorShippingZoneCode.hint: The zone the shop ships to most. Its shipping rate feeds the floor price calculation.

autoDropSchedule.label: Automatic markdown schedule
autoDropSchedule.hint: One stage per line, written days:percent. The percentage applies to the original price, never to the already reduced one. Leave empty to disable markdowns.

offersOpenAfterDays.label: Offers open after (days)
offersOpenAfterDays.hint: How long after publication a piece becomes negotiable. At zero it never sells at the listed price: buyers just wait.

offerResponseHours.label: Response window (hours)
offerResponseHours.hint: How long you have to answer before an offer expires.

acceptedOfferValidityHours.label: Accepted price validity (hours)
acceptedOfferValidityHours.hint: How long the buyer has to pay at the negotiated price.

minOfferAmountCents.label: Minimum offer (cents)
minOfferAmountCents.hint: Absolute floor across all pieces. Keeps nuisance offers out.

maxOffersPerArticlePerUser.label: Offers per piece, per person
maxOffersPerArticlePerUser.hint: How many times the same person may bid on the same piece.

offerCooldownAfterRejectionHours.label: Cooldown after refusal (hours)
offerCooldownAfterRejectionHours.hint: Without it, a refusal is worked around by resending the same offer one cent higher.

autoAcceptOffersEnabled.label: Automatic acceptance
autoAcceptOffersEnabled.hint: Not recommended. Once buyers find out a low offer goes through by itself, the listed price becomes decorative.

autoAcceptThresholdPercent.label: Automatic acceptance threshold (%)
autoAcceptThresholdPercent.hint: Share of the listed price above which an offer passes on its own. Leave empty for none. The floor price stays unbreakable either way.

reservationTtlMinutes.label: Cart reservation (minutes)
reservationTtlMinutes.hint: How long a piece stays held while payment goes through.

homeHeroImageUrl.label: Home page banner image
homeHeroImageUrl.hint: Cloudinary address of the landscape photo shown on arrival. Leave empty until a photograph exists: the slot then stays plain, with no broken image.
